Poll asynchronous native world-list population before selecting the uniquely owned fixture.
Treat malformed model JSON as bounded model feedback instead of a host failure.
Reserve mandatory post-decision V0/I0 and one final model action around late inspection.
Retain bounded private malformed replies and nonzero model-process exit metadata for future diagnosis.
